characters.summary: Princess Jasmine is a resourceful royal who relies primarily on agility, disguise, persuasion, and her tiger companion Rajah to navigate threats. She lacks overt superhuman powers but utilizes environment, quick thinking, and occasional defensive concealment.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical capture and imprisonment due to human physiology
mobility: riding (Magic Carpet, though piloted primarily by Aladdin)
limitations: Possesses no innate magical abilities or superhuman strength

sources.supports: General character abilities, backstory, and plot events in Aladdin.

unknowns: Exact combat proficiency against trained warriors outside of brief defensive struggles.

characters.summary: Jerry the mouse utilizes extreme toon physics, remarkable speed, improvised traps, and environmental objects to outwit and torment his feline adversary Tom. He exhibits cartoon durability and ingenuity on a microscopic scale.

mechanisms: Hiding in mouseholes and tight spaces

limitations: Physically weak compared to larger animals without tools or traps

sources.supports: Classic cartoon traits, physics defiance, and typical antics of Jerry.

notableResults.note: Wins through clever trap placement and outsmarting Tom's direct attacks.

unknowns: True biological limits due to shifting cartoon physics rules across different directors.

characters.summary: Johnny Bravo relies on sheer exaggerated muscular strength, striking poses, and over-the-top physical comedy. While he boasts of his prowess, his combat effectiveness is often hampered by his narcissism and low intellect.

mechanisms: Thick hair acting as a cushion

limitations: Lack of tactical intelligence often leads to self-sabotage

sources.supports: Character traits, physical gags, and general series background.

unknowns: Consistency of his physical strength feats when not played purely for laughs.

characters.summary: Katara is a master waterbender who manipulates water, ice, and steam for offensive blasts, defensive barriers, and precise healing. Her training under both Northern Tribe masters and Pakku makes her one of the world's most formidable benders.

mechanisms: Self-healing using water and focused energy

weaknesses: Deprivation of water sources severely limits her offensive output
Extreme cold can freeze her water supplies if not controlled
limitations: Requires external water or moisture unless drawing from sweat/plants

sources.supports: Katara's waterbending mastery, healing abilities, and background.

feats.claim: Defeats Azula in Agni Kai using smart environmental tactics
feats.citation: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 3, Episode 21

notableResults.citation: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 3, Episode 21
notableResults.note: Won with Zuko's initial help and trapping Azula in ice.

campaignTags.claim: Heals wounds using glowing water and spiritual focus
Manipulates water, ice, and steam in combat

unknowns: Whether she continued using bloodbending outside of extreme vengeance scenarios.

characters.summary: King Triton is the ruler of Atlantica, wielding the magical Trident which grants immense energy projection, weather control, and shape-shifting powers. He commands marine life and possesses vast superhuman might underwater.

mechanisms: Magical force fields generated via the Trident
Durability of an immortal sea god

weaknesses: Loss of the Trident strips him of his primary magical power source
limitations: Vulnerable when disarmed of the Trident

sources.supports: King Triton's role, power of the Trident, and magical feats.

feats.claim: Destroys Ariel's collection of human artifacts with an energy blast from the Trident

notableResults.note: Surrendered the Trident to Ursula under coercion to save Ariel.

campaignTags.claim: Breathes underwater as a merman king
Wields the magical Trident capable of energy projection and transformation

unknowns: Limits of his physical combat skill without the magical Trident.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 0/3 key terms found): water-breathing: Innate aquatic biology

characters.summary: Leonardo is the disciplined leader of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, skilled in ninjutsu and wielding twin ninjato swords. He combines tactical planning, acrobatic agility, and strict martial arts training in combat.
weaknesses: Carries heavy responsibility for his brothers, which can be exploited
limitations: Relies entirely on physical martial arts and standard steel weaponry

sources.supports: Leonardo's weapons, leadership role, and martial arts background.

feats.claim: Leads the turtles in successful infiltrations of the Technodrome

campaignTags.claim: Trained in ninjutsu stealth and infiltration tactics

unknowns: Power scaling variations between the 1987 cartoon and darker comic/movie continuities.

characters.summary: Lightning McQueen is a sentient, highly modified stock car capable of extreme racing speeds and tight cornering maneuvers. While lacking limbs or traditional offensive weaponry, his velocity and mass make him dangerous if used as a ram.
weaknesses: Inability to traverse non-paved or vertical terrain easily without specific modifications
Dependent on fuel and mechanical maintenance
limitations: Cannot operate without a functioning engine and fuel

sources.supports: Character origin as a Piston Cup race car and automotive capabilities.

notableResults.note: Wins the moral victory and championship context by stopping to help the injured King.

unknowns: How physics apply to a world entirely populated by sentient vehicles.

characters.summary: Lilo Pelekai is a young human girl skilled in unconventional problem-solving, local Hawaiian traditions, and utilizing her alien companion Stitch's immense destructive capabilities. She fights with resourcefulness and psychological persuasion rather than brute force.
limitations: Has no innate superhuman physical or magical powers

sources.supports: Lilo's role, friendship with Stitch, and resourcefulness.

unknowns: Combat viability independently of her alien experiments.

characters.summary: Lisa Simpson is an intellectually gifted eight-year-old child whose combat style centers on verbal debate, saxophone playing as a sonic distraction, and environmental activism. She possesses no combat training or superhuman abilities.
weaknesses: Child physiology makes her physically weak against adults or aggressive peers
limitations: No combat skills or physical strength

sources.supports: Lisa's characteristics as an intellectual child and musician.

unknowns: Any hypothetical future martial arts training shown in flash-forward episodes.

characters.summary: Lola Bunny is an athletic, fast-moving cartoon rabbit gifted in basketball acrobatics, lightning-fast reflexes, and cartoon elasticity. She combines acrobatic flair with high-speed movement.
weaknesses: Over-reliance on style and agility over heavy defense
limitations: Lacks heavy projectile weapons or magical attacks

sources.supports: Lola Bunny's introduction, athletic skills, and Space Jam appearance.

feats.claim: Performs high-flying dunks and acrobatic evasion against Monstars

unknowns: Discrepancies in depiction between the 1996 Space Jam and later reboots/The Looney Tunes Show.
